sources.name: Deriv public market-data API

historical.representation: history.prices and history.times parallel arrays, or candles array
historical.limitations: License-adjusted intervals and latest available results are documented. Complete individual tick history, pagination tie handling and Boom 1000 retention are not established.

streaming.authentication: Public market-data channel documented without authentication or OTP
streaming.response: Optional tick object. Only tick.pip_size is required inside tick in the published schema.
streaming.reconnect_guidance: Documented exponential backoff, jitter and periodic ping; no gap-free replay guarantee found.

timestamps.current_f04_compatibility: Requires explicit source-specific epoch interpretation and history-array expansion. F04 historical.v1 accepts ISO8601 only.

prices.representation: JSON number; decode exactly as Decimal
prices.quote_basis: quote described as market value; do not relabel it bid, ask or last
prices.display_precision: tick.pip_size and history response pip_size describe decimal display places
prices.metadata_warning: Active-symbol comparison example pip_size is a fractional increment. Do not cast it to canonical integer decimal places. Verify API version and units.

access.reason: API Users terms section 2.1 prohibits feed-content storage; section 2.3 permits caching for up to 24 hours. Intended durable research archival needs applicable permission clarification.
access.rate_limits: Published shared budgets; recheck official limits before any adapter. No connection or subscription capacity was measured.

documentation.claim: Official CFD instrument listing includes Boom 1000 Index. It does not establish an Options API identifier or availability.
Public Options market-data channel requires no authentication or OTP and excludes account-scoped operations.
New symbol metadata uses underlying_symbol and underlying_symbol_name. No Boom 1000 response was obtained.
History supports ticks or candles, explicit boundaries and count, license adjustment and optional subscription. New count default is 1000, not a retention guarantee.
History uses parallel price/time arrays; candles use OHLC and epoch. History and arrays are optional in the response schema.
Optional tick contains optional epoch, quote, bid, ask, symbol and id, with pip_size required. tick.id is documented as a per-connection identifier usable to unsubscribe, not a durable event ID.
Reconnection guidance describes exponential backoff, jitter, periodic ping, error handling and subscription cleanup.
WebSocket requests share per-minute and per-hour budgets. Limits can change.
Version R26|03, updated 2026-10-16. Sections 2.1 and 2.3 restrict feed storage and permit only temporary caching up to 24 hours.

limitations: API documentation is not proof that the Boom 1000 CFD instrument is available on the public Options market-data API.
No authorized genuine market sample supplied or inspected.
No complete history, ordering, unique event identity or loss-free delivery guarantee established.
Published schemas on the master branch can change. These are date-stamped documentation observations, not deployed API captures.
blockers: Resolve permitted durable storage and research use with applicable source terms or explicit provider permission.
Verify the exact external identifier and availability on this API without assuming a CFD display name is an API symbol.
Obtain an authorized genuine recording and verified precision, price semantics, timestamp units and coverage metadata.
Review a future F04 epoch/array adapter and continuity policy separately.

sources.name: Authorized Deriv MT5 terminal recording
sources.publisher: Deriv market data; MetaQuotes terminal interface
formats: authorized JSON or JSON Lines recording

historical.ordering: MQL5 CopyTicksRange documents oldest-to-newest order and inclusive millisecond boundaries.
historical.limitations: Server/terminal history availability and synchronization apply. Range calls can return partial results or errors. Candles do not reconstruct individual ticks.

streaming.mechanism: Terminal NewTick event in an MQL5 EA; Python snapshot calls are not an event subscription
streaming.limitations: A NewTick event is not queued while one is queued or processing. OnTick alone cannot prove retention of every terminal tick. No bridge or EA is implemented in F00.

timestamps.representation: UTC terminal times; time_msc is price-update time in milliseconds
timestamps.current_f04_compatibility: Authorized export with explicit ISO8601 UTC timestamps can use a reviewed historical.v1 profile. Native numeric epochs need a separate adapter.

prices.representation: MqlTick double fields; recorded decimal text must state exporter precision
prices.quote_basis: Choose and record one field explicitly; do not assume last is populated for this instrument
prices.precision: Verify exact terminal symbol digits and point from symbol_info; observed digits in a file are not a provider guarantee

access.requirements: Authorized terminal with applicable server history and market-data access; exact deployment/entitlements not established
access.reason: Terminal API documentation establishes technical interfaces, not rights to archive or redistribute Deriv data. Applicable terms and recording authorization must be supplied.

documentation.claim: Official CFD listing names Boom 1000 Index; no terminal symbol metadata was captured.
MqlTick supplies time, bid, ask, last, volume, time_msc, flags and volume_real. Fields can retain values unchanged from the previous update.
Tick range retrieval is ordered past-to-present with inclusive millisecond boundaries; timeout and small-buffer cases can return partial history.
Python terminal tick retrieval uses explicit range/flags. Returned market times are UTC.
Candle retrieval is limited to available chart history and configured maximum bars.
NewTick triggers EA callbacks but another NewTick is not queued if one is queued or executing.
symbol_info retrieves terminal-specific symbol properties, including digits and point. Example forex symbols are not Boom identity evidence.

limitations: Generic MetaQuotes interfaces do not establish a particular Deriv server's Boom 1000 history depth, symbol or precision.
No authorized genuine terminal sample, server identity, or export metadata was supplied.
Terminal tick snapshots, Options API quotes, bid, ask and last must not be treated as interchangeable.
blockers: Obtain applicable recording/storage permission and an authorized sample with acquisition provenance.
Verify terminal symbol identity, digits, point, chosen price basis, UTC export and available history.
Verify completeness and reconnect recovery before a future collector integration.
